description: Defines the Err class for error handling, including error details, sub-errors, and printing methods, used in the GN build system.

classes.name: Err
classes.description: Represents an error with location, message, help text, sub-errors, and printing capabilities.

methods.name: Err
methods.description: Constructors for different error types (single point, range, token, node, value).

methods.name: PrintToStdout
methods.description: Prints the error details to standard output.

methods.name: PrintNonfatalToStdout
methods.description: Prints the error as a warning, indicating non-fatal error.

methods.name: AppendSubErr
methods.description: Adds a sub-error to the current error.

methods.name: set_toolchain_label
methods.description: Associates a toolchain label with the error.
